name: Commons Fridge Functional Prototype v1.6 (bilingual build)
languageNote: Both language tables ship in the same file and are switched at runtime from the header. The choice is remembered in localStorage; the first visit follows the browser language.
evidenceBoundary: Researcher-tested technical demonstrator; not participant usability validation.
notes: Routes are URL hash fragments resolved in the browser; the server returns the same document for all of them. Correct routing must be confirmed on a real phone.

Ownership, plan and zone kind are persisted as stable keys, so records saved by v1.0, v1.2, v1.4 and v1.5 migrate automatically. Fields introduced later stay empty on older records rather than being guessed.
The House view groups records by zone, never by person. No names, avatars or initials anywhere; the handled receipt clears itself after 48 hours so no history of who did what accumulates.
Nothing is synced. The House view shows fictional records held in this one browser, and the interface says so on screen rather than in a footnote.
Switching language re-seeds the demo records only while they are untouched; anything the viewer typed is left exactly as they wrote it.
No camera, upload, account, analytics, timer or notification API.
